Product leader with eight years of experience shipping B2C health and fintech products used by millions. I pair qualitative research with rigorous experimentation, and I love turning messy problems into clear, measurable roadmaps that engineering and design teams rally behind.
• Lead a 14-person squad owning onboarding and care plans for 2.3M members
• Redesigned onboarding, lifting 30-day retention from 41% to 58%
• Launched in-app coaching, now 18% of new subscription revenue
• Hired and mentored three product managers
• Owned the shipment tracking experience across web, iOS and Android
• Cut “where is my order” support tickets by 37% with proactive alerts
• Introduced a quarterly discovery ritual adopted by four other teams
• Shipped savings goals, the bank’s most-used feature within six months
• Ran 40+ A/B tests on the account-opening flow (+12% completion)
University of Washington, Foster School of Business
• “Retention is a product problem” — Mind the Product, Seattle 2025
